prompt: could you give some activities one could do with kids when the weather is bad
response: When the weather is bad, it's a great time to get creative indoors! You could try baking cookies or cupcakes with your kids, which is not only fun but also teaches them basic cooking skills. Another idea is to set up an indoor treasure hunt with clues hidden around the house. This keeps them active and engaged. You could also spend the day watching movies or having a movie marathon. These activities are sure to keep the kids entertained and make for a fun day indoors.
